about: Copies of examples/testnet-01, the real round on the Zcash test network, where the seller changed their own files. The chain cannot be changed, so every copy is checked against the real chain.json. Run with --scan --chain examples/testnet-01/chain.json. A real cheat fails several checks at once; expectedFailingChecks lists them all.

copies.name: 01-hidden-losing-bid
copies.story: The seller leaves the losing bid of 1,500,000 and its refund out of their files, then says that with only two bids the price falls to the reserve of 1,000,000. The refunds on the chain no longer add up, and the scan of the real blocks finds the bid and the refund the seller left out.

copies.name: 02-short-refund-claim
copies.story: The seller's result says the losing bidder got 1,400,000 back. The chain shows the real refund was 1,500,000, so the seller's sums are 100,000 out and the result contradicts itself.
